description: Which nights are free between two dates, both inclusive, at most 62 days per call. Each night has available, minStay, whether arrival/departure is allowed that day, and priceCents (null when the place takes no online booking). For the price of a whole stay use get_quote – nightly prices do not include fees or discounts.

slug.description: The place's slug – the last part of its page URL (posadita.com/p/{slug}), or from search_stays or /llms.txt.
